intro.text: A city in the Central Dominance of the Final Empire.
A city in the Central Dominance of the Final Empire, at least two days' ride north of Luthadel.

description.text: It lies at least two days' ride north of Luthadel, and three days' march from Holstep and the Arguois caverns.

items.text: When the skaa rebel army attacked the much smaller garrison at nearby Holstep, the Holstep troops got a messenger to Valtroux. The Valtroux Garrison, five thousand strong, marched for Holstep at once.

Under orders to take no prisoners, the Valtroux troops destroyed the rebels before Kelsier and Vin could arrive, and set the heads of Yeden and other officers on spears beside a road. Only Demoux's group, which had stayed out of the attack and hidden, survived.
The rebels fought better than past uprisings, but, just out of the Holstep battle, they could not match a fully trained garrison of the same size.
Soon after, the Luthadel Garrison arrived to relieve the Valtroux troops and went on searching for rebels who had fled.
